correctness.rationale: For A_epsilon=diag(1,1+epsilon,2) and normalized start proportional to (1,1,epsilon), the first Ritz residual has the exact squared norm epsilon^2(epsilon^2-2epsilon+3)/(epsilon^2+2)^2. A stable basis of K_2 is u_epsilon=(1,1,epsilon)^T and w_epsilon=(-1,0,1-epsilon)^T. Its exact Gram and projected matrices converge to a definite pencil with generalized eigenvalues 1 and 5/3; the simple top Ritz vector converges to (-1,1,2)^T/sqrt(6), whose residual norm is sqrt(2)/3. Hence the residual ratio is asymptotic to 2sqrt(6)/(9epsilon). Rayleigh--Ritz maximality gives theta_epsilon>rho_epsilon, while e_3 is not in K_2, so theta_epsilon<2. In dimensions below three, the second Krylov space is either unchanged or the full space, making a nonzero second Ritz residual impossible.

originality.rationale: Classical Rayleigh--Ritz/Lanczos theory, residual-based Ritz-vector diagnostics, near-breakdown terminology, and generic spectral-filter residual distortion are treated as prior work. The full Jia--Stewart report was inspected through its Rayleigh--Ritz definition, Ritz-value and Ritz-vector convergence theorems, residual bounds, refined Ritz construction, and discussion. The Paige--Panayotov source was inspected through its exact Hermitian Lanczos setup and Ritz-residual framework. Neither inspected source states the fixed-condition-number-three-dimensional family, the divergent one-to-two-step largest-Ritz residual ratio, the simultaneous strict Ritz-value improvement, or the dimension-three minimality. Focused published-record searches did not locate an implication-equivalent statement.
residual_risks: Older Lanczos near-breakdown literature is extensive, and an equivalent three-dimensional exact-arithmetic example may exist under different terminology.
The result compares the extremal Ritz pair selected independently at two nested dimensions; it is not a same-branch eigenvector continuation theorem.
The nearby prescribed-spectral-filter result is conceptually related, although the adaptive Rayleigh--Ritz selection and the fixed-condition-number minimal family are not supplied by it.

value.rationale: Largest Ritz values enjoy a variational monotonicity property, while Ritz residuals are standard convergence and stopping diagnostics in Hermitian eigensolvers. The finding shows that these two natural indicators can diverge maximally in relative terms at an exact-arithmetic near-breakdown: the matrix condition number remains two, the largest Ritz value strictly improves, yet the residual ratio is unbounded. The minimal dimension, explicit asymptotic constant, and mechanism through a clustered spectrum make this a motivated boundary phenomenon rather than an arbitrary small example.
